fragrance_1.speaker: fragrance
fragrance_1.text: Two truths and a lie. I'm in your shampoo. I'm in your detergent. I'm in unscented products.

narrator.speaker: narrator
narrator.text: Read the profile, not just the front of the bottle.

fragrance.text: Hey. It's me again. I know, I know, you said you were done, but honestly? You always come back. Everybody does. Anyway. Call me.

narrator.text: Every label tells a story. Some of it is on the front, and the rest is in the fine print. Here is how to read the whole thing.
